programme.title: Mothra vs. Godzilla
programme.desc: Japan comes under attack from two monsters in a giant monster battle between a rampaging Godzilla and the colossal genetically engineered moth called Mothra.

programme.title: Furiosa: A Mad Max Saga
programme.desc: Young Furiosa gets caught in the crossfire of two tyrannical warlords. As the tyrants fight for dominance, Furiosa soon finds herself in a nonstop battle to make her way home.

programme.title: The Alto Knights
programme.desc: The Alto Knights follow two of New York's most notorious crime bosses and how their separate paths to power place them on a deadly collision course.

programme.title: Opus
programme.desc: A journalist is invited to the remote compound of a legendary pop star who mysteriously disappeared 30 years ago. Surrounded by the star's cult of sycophants, she gets caught in the middle of his twisted plan.

programme.title: The Family
programme.desc: After snitching on the mob, a Mafia boss (Robert De Niro) and his family enter the Witness Protection Program and relocate to a sleepy town in France, but their insistence on resorting to their old habits places them in danger from vengeful cronies.

programme.title: The Man
programme.desc: A case of mistaken identity leaves an ATF agent (Samuel L. Jackson) squabbling with a talkative salesman (Eugene Levy) in his custody.

programme.title: The Best Exotic Marigold Hotel
programme.desc: British retirees (Judi Dench, Maggie Smith, Bill Nighy) move to India to live out their golden years and find that their new home is a dilapidated hotel.

programme.title: The Art of Getting By
programme.desc: A high-school senior (Freddie Highmore) has a fatalistic outlook on life but slowly starts to change his view after meeting a free-spirited classmate (Emma Roberts).

programme.desc: A restaurateur (Meryl Streep) falls into an affair with her remarried ex-husband (Alec Baldwin), while an architect (Steve Martin) that she hired to refurbish her kitchen falls in love with her.

programme.title: Love Happens

programme.title: Yucatan, le Mexique Maya

programme.title: Alexia: autopsie d'un féminicide

programme.title: Affaire Lambin: le berger tueur en série?

programme.title: Les duos de l'histoire de l'art

programme.desc: Paul Finebaum shares compelling opinions on SEC football and interacts with passionate callers.

programme.title: NFL Football
programme.desc: Football action from around the National Football League.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: A tension-laden Egg Bowl sees Lane Kiffin's No. 7 Rebels (10-1, 6-1 SEC) visit the Bulldogs (5-6, 1-6). Kiffin is soon expected to decide on his future employment, with LSU and Florida reportedly in pursuit of the 50-year-old Ole Miss head coach.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The No. 8 Sooners take on the No. 22 Tigers. Oklahoma leads the all-time rivalry series 67-25-5, but Missouri won the first meeting as SEC equals in 2024. Oklahoma has defeated then-No. 14 Tennessee and then-No. 4 Alabama on the road in November.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The No. 5 Bulldogs host the No. 10 Longhorns. In 2024, Georgia beat Texas 30-15 in the regular season, and 22-19 in overtime in the SEC title game. Texas held off then-No. 9 Vanderbilt for a fourth straight win Nov. 1. Georgia has won five in a row.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The No. 3 Aggies (9-0, 6-0 SEC) line up against the Gamecocks (3-6, 1-6) at Kyle Field. South Carolina won two of the last three meetings, but is 0-5 when facing Texas A&M at College Station. The Aggies are 9-0 for the first time since 1992.

programme.title: SEC Storied
programme.desc: Exploring the athletic history of the Southeastern Conference, from the athletes and coaches to defining games and moments.

programme.title: SEC Start Up
programme.desc: Comprehensive coverage of SEC football, basketball, baseball and more, including live games, scores, schedules, standings and news.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The No. 3 Aggies (8-0, 5-0 SEC) travel for a showdown with the No. 22 Tigers (6-2, 2-2). Missouri hasn't beaten Texas A&M since 2014, dropping both matches since then. The Aggies have their highest AP ranking since 1995, when they also reached No. 3.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The No. 9 Commodores (7-1, 3-1 SEC) visit the No. 20 Longhorns (6-2, 3-1). Texas defeated Vanderbilt 27-24 in 2024 in the first meeting since 1928. Vandy hung on for a 17-10 victory last week as a Hail Mary pass by Missouri came up one yard short.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The Wildcats return from a week off and take on the Gamecocks. Kentucky moved to 2-1 on the season before its bye week by dumping Eastern Michigan 48-23 on Sept. 13. South Carolina fell to 0-2 in SEC play after a 29-20 loss at then-No. 23 Missouri.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The No. 5 Bulldogs (3-0, 1-0 SEC) take on the No. 17 Crimson Tide (2-1, 0-0). Alabama has won both meetings since Georgia claimed the 2021 title over the Tide. Ryan Williams (ALA) posted 177 receiving yards in last year's 41-34 win.

programme.title: Infractions
